column7: ActivateBreakGlass wrote break_glass.activated best-effort after the commit, so a failed audit append left a live grant with no chain record. The grant, the activation row and both audit rows now commit in one fail-closed transaction (AUDIT-TX-2); if the audit log refuses them the activation commits degraded with a short expiry and a pending_audit_events record of each row in the same transaction (BREAKGLASS-OWED-1), and if that fails too nothing commits and the activation is refused with ErrBreakGlassUnrecordable (HTTP 503). Same fix and tests as BREAKGLASS-OWED-001..004 and BREAKGLASS-OWED-PG-001; this row records that #3420 itself is closed. Re-verified at e1d550c61 by CORE-ORDER-RACES-NOV-1 (2026-11-14).
